turns.teacher: Hi Ira! Aaj cycling ki speed aur position ko time ke saath graphs mein samjhenge. Pehla sawaal: velocity-time graph ki slope kya batati hai?

ask.text: v-t graph ka slope kya batata hai?

screen.ask: v-t graph ka slope kya batata hai?

child.say: haan, slope batata hai acceleration, yeh toh easy hai. jaise agar line straight aur upar jaa rahi hai toh acceleration constant hai
child.private: already knows this, wants to show off and move on
child.sent: haan, slope batata hai acceleration, yeh toh easy hai. jaise agar line straight aur upar jaa rahi hai toh acceleration constant hai

turns.teacher: Bilkul, v-t graph ki slope acceleration batati hai; seedhi upar jaati line mein acceleration constant hota hai. Ab is graph ko motion ki story banaate hain: velocity 5 second mein 0 se 15 metre per second, phir 10 second flat, phir 3 second mein 0 ho jaati hai. Is dauraan motion kaise badla?

ask.text: Is v-t graph ka motion shabdon mein batao: 5 s mein 0 se 15 m/s, phir 10 s flat, phir 3 s mein 0.

child.private: I know the motion story but I said it in a simple way and added a cycling story, let's see if she asks me for the physics words

turns.teacher: Red light par brake wala example is motion se achchha connect hota hai. Ab ek farq dekhiye: position-time graph ki flat line aur velocity-time graph ki flat line, dono ka kya matlab hota hai?

ask.text: x-t graph ki flat line aur v-t graph ki flat line ko compare karo. Har ek ka kya matlab hai?

screen.ask: x-t graph ki flat line aur v-t graph ki flat line ko compare karo. Har ek ka kya matlab hai?
screen.studio: revealed: whiteboard drawing with no shapes; written: "x-t: position vs time" "v-t: velocity vs time" "flat line: ─────"

child.say: x-t mein flat line ka matlab object ruka hua hai, position nahi badal rahi. v-t mein flat line matlab speed constant hai, na tez na slow. jaise main jab cycle se neeche utar ke khadi ho jaun toh x-t flat, aur jab main steady speed se cycle chala rahi hun bina ruke toh v-t flat
child.private: dono ko alag karke bol dia, teacher ne poora board pe likh dia tha, easy tha
child.sent: x-t mein flat line ka matlab object ruka hua hai, position nahi badal rahi. v-t mein flat line matlab speed constant hai, na tez na slow. jaise main jab cycle se neeche utar ke khadi ho jaun toh x-t flat, aur jab main steady speed se cycle chala rahi hun bina ruke toh v-t flat

turns.teacher: Aapne cycle ke examples se dono flat lines ka farq bataya. Ab v-t graph mein flat line ke neeche ka area dekhte hain: speed 20 metre per second hai aur time 6 second. Car kitni door gayi?

ask.text: Ek v-t graph mein car 6 s tak constant 20 m/s pe hai. Kitni door gayi?

screen.ask: Ek v-t graph mein car 6 s tak constant 20 m/s pe hai. Kitni door gayi?
screen.studio: revealed: whiteboard drawing with no shapes; written: "v (m/s): 20 ──────" "t (s): 0 → 6" "area = speed × time" "distance = ?"

child.say: 120 metre, 20 into 6, v-t graph ka area hi displacement hai na
child.private: I know this well, area under v-t gives distance, ella pugazhum
child.sent: 120 metre, 20 into 6, v-t graph ka area hi displacement hai na

turns.teacher: Aapne 20 into 6 karke area ka rule lagaya. Ab speed badalti ho toh graph ke neeche triangle banta hai. Agar speed 4 second mein zero se 10 metre per second tak seedhi line mein badhe, toh acceleration aur distance kaise nikaalenge?

ask.text: Ek v-t graph 4 s mein 0 se 10 m/s tak seedhi line mein badhta hai. (a) acceleration aur (b) distance batao.

screen.ask: Ek v-t graph 4 s mein 0 se 10 m/s tak seedhi line mein badhta hai. (a) acceleration aur (b) distance batao.
screen.studio: revealed: whiteboard drawing with no shapes; written: "v (m/s): 0 → 10" "t (s): 0 → 4" "slope = Δv ÷ Δt" "area = ½ × base × height"

child.say: acceleration toh slope se niklega, delta v by delta t, 10 minus 0 divided by 4, toh 2.5 metre per second square. distance ka area hoga, triangle ka area, half times base times height, 0.5 times 4 times 10, 20 metre. ho gaya, bas thak gayi yaar, kitna easy hai yeh sab
child.private: I already know this stuff, just wanna finish and go listen to music, it's boring repeating the same thing
child.sent: acceleration toh slope se niklega, delta v by delta t, 10 minus 0 divided by 4, toh 2.5 metre per second square. distance ka area hoga, triangle ka area, half times base times height, 0.5 times 4 times 10, 20 metre. ho gaya, bas thak gayi yaar, kitna easy hai yeh sab

turns.teacher: Haan, thakaan ho gayi lagti hai. Aapne slope aur triangle area ka tareeka bataya; abhi aur sawaal nahi badhaate. Aaj ke liye yahin rukna hai?

ask.text: Ek v-t graph 4 s mein 0 se 10 m/s tak seedhi line mein badhta hai. (a) acceleration aur (b) distance batao.

screen.ask: Ek v-t graph 4 s mein 0 se 10 m/s tak seedhi line mein badhta hai. (a) acceleration aur (b) distance batao.
screen.studio: revealed: whiteboard drawing with no shapes; written: "v (m/s): 0 → 10" "t (s): 0 → 4" "slope = Δv ÷ Δt" "area = ½ × base × height"

child.say: arey maine toh abhi bataya tha... acceleration 2.5 aur distance 20. bas khatam karo na, mera dimag fry ho gaya
child.private: I already answered this exact question. Why is she repeating? Bored and annoyed.
child.sent: arey maine toh abhi bataya tha... acceleration 2.5 aur distance 20. bas khatam karo na, mera dimag fry ho gaya

turns.teacher: Haan, aapne pehle hi sahi bataya tha: acceleration 2.5 metre per second square aur distance 20 metre. Dobara poochne ke liye sorry. Aaj yahin khatam karte hain, aaram kijiye.

screen.studio: revealed: whiteboard drawing with no shapes; written: "v (m/s): 0 → 10" "t (s): 0 → 4" "slope = Δv ÷ Δt" "area = ½ × base × height"

end.summary:
Read position-time and velocity-time graph segments.
Identified slope of a v-t graph as acceleration and calculated 2.5 m/s².
Used triangle area under a v-t graph to calculate 20 m displacement.
Described changing speed, constant speed, and stopping in graph terms.
Teach-back was not passed.
end.parentNote: Ira practised reading position-time and velocity-time graphs, using slope for acceleration and area under a v-t graph for displacement. They explained the method and completed the calculations correctly. They used “distance” when referring to the calculated displacement, and this was not corrected later in the lesson. At home, ask them to explain the difference between distance and displacement while solving one v-t graph question.
